description: Arrange layers one after another in time, in the order given, optionally overlapping with an opacity dissolve (Animation > Keyframe Assistant > Sequence Layers)

comp.description: Which composition. Give its item id (from list_items) or name; omit for the active composition

layers.description: Which layers. Give indexes (1-based, from list_layers), names, or selected: true. The first plays first

overlap.description: Seconds each layer overlaps the one before. Default 0

start.description: When the first layer starts (seconds). Default its current in point

transition.description: With an overlap: off (default), dissolve_front (the upper layer fades), or cross_dissolve (both fade)

name: sequence_layers
title: Sequence Layers
